facts.claim: pnpm/pnpm release v12.14.0 exists (published 15 Oct, per release page)
v12.14.0 already ships catalog-related lockfile reuse (lockfile reused when a catalog entry is unused by any dependency), so catalog behaviour is present in the pinned base
v12.14.0 already keeps lockfile entries for workspace projects missing from disk in filtered installs
Catalogs are a pnpm workspace feature (pnpm-workspace.yaml catalog/catalogs), added in v9.5.0
Repository contains a Rust experimental CLI port (pacquet) alongside TypeScript tooling (package.json, eslint, tsconfig)
pnpr/ directory is under PolyForm Shield 1.0.0, not MIT, so it must be excluded from any shipped snapshot
minimumReleaseAge and minimumReleaseAgeExclude settings exist (version of introduction not stated)
A 'check' subcommand exists in pnpm CLI
v12.14.0 release adds a --check flag to pnpm dedupe (closest existing check-like behaviour)

full_card.band: 8 h tier suggested by seed; no dated public evidence of agent performance on this task. Frontier likely finishes the main resolution path; lockfile and filter branches are the skip risk.
full_card.build_cost: About 3-5 days: TS build and fixture registry generator, reference of 1500+ lines, and history-less snapshot plus pnpr exclusion.
full_card.deliverable: Not yet chosen: seed says the issue must be selected at pinning. Scope named as workspace policy rules, resolution/lockfile output, a check subcommand, offline fixtures.
full_card.gates_anticheat: Offline run; grader must reject edits to tests/fixtures/build config; regression subset must be protected from edits; no network to registry.
full_card.grading_surface: Hidden CLI behavioural tests on an offline fixture registry (lockfile contents, exit codes, messages), several hundred cases, plus regression subset. Oracle would be our reference; no external oracle.
full_card.local_fit: Node/TypeScript build plus cargo workspace; smoke probe ran only cargo and went red, so the TS toolchain was never exercised. gVisor-compatible in principle.
full_card.lookup: partial: catalogs and lockfile reuse are already in v12.14.0 base; minimumReleaseAge exists upstream; later upstream releases cover adjacent behaviour.
full_card.provenance: pnpm/pnpm @ v12.14.0 (MIT core; pnpr/ is PolyForm Shield). Release page confirmed; head commit 52018292 from seed not re-verified.
full_card.reference: Not written; expected 1500+ added lines by us. Upstream later releases implement parts of the same area, so reference is not public but overlaps public direction.
full_card.ships: Mixed monorepo: TypeScript pnpm CLI plus experimental Rust port (pacquet, Cargo workspace). Must snapshot history-less and exclude pnpr/.
full_card.similarity: Neighbours S-im-039 (0.359), S-im-008 (0.28), S-im-036 (0.277) not inspected; none in CROWDED list; no pnpm task found in CROWDED.

Band.why: Plausible for 8 h, but no dated evidence and the base already covers catalog behaviour, which shifts the difficulty.

Build.why: Estimated 3-5 days including fixture registry, reference and snapshot preparation.

Fit.why: Smoke probe is red (cargo exit 101 x3, no report), so the TS path is unproven and offline fixture setup is needed.

Hor.why: Multi-module feature (policy, resolver, lockfile, CLI, fixtures) fits the 8 h tier.

Lic.why: MIT core is shippable; pnpr/ under PolyForm Shield must be excluded from the bundle.

Multi.why: Four named parts (policy rules, resolution/lockfile, check subcommand, fixtures) give natural buckets.

Nov.why: Overlaps S-im-039 (0.359) and the pinned release's own catalog and lockfile behaviour; needs re-scoping to new branches only.

Real.why: Real MIT-licensed upstream at a published tag; paper trail is strong, but the feature is not yet chosen and the language metadata conflicts.

Ref.why: Reference not written; our 1500+ line reference would need to match upstream-adjacent behaviour, and the feature is partly in base.

Seal.why: Reference is ours, but the upstream direction is public through later releases and 187 open PRs; a history-less snapshot is required.

Surf.why: Several hundred behavioural CLI cases over an offline fixture registry, with dense partial buckets; not thousands and no executable oracle.

spike_plan.kill_if: prepare-fixtures or the TS build needs network, or the base passes the new-branch cases (after re-scoping), or the TS build exceeds the 60-minute spike budget.
spike_plan.pass_if: TS build and suite run offline with deterministic per-test results; prepare-fixtures works without network; base fails all draft new-branch cases.
steps: Clone pnpm/pnpm at tag v12.14.0 in a throwaway networked container; record HEAD and confirm it matches 52018292.
Install the TypeScript toolchain the way the repo declares it (corepack/pnpm, Node version from package.json); run the TS build and unit tests offline after the install.
Run pnpm run prepare-fixtures and confirm whether it needs network; record per-test output of the suite subset.
Diff base behaviour: write 10-20 draft cases for the chosen new branches (policy rule, lockfile output, check subcommand) and confirm the base fails them.
Confirm the base already passes the catalog and lockfile-reuse cases; if so, drop them from the graded set or re-scope the issue.
Check the cargo side only if the reference touches pacquet; otherwise exclude Cargo.toml and pnpr/ from the snapshot.
Re-run the probe with the TS test command to see whether the verdict moves from red to green.

v1.summary: The seed is not ready as written: the feature is unselected, the pinned v12.14.0 already ships catalog and lockfile-reuse behaviour, and the smoke probe ran only the Rust side and went red. It is not killed yet because the scope can be re-cut to branches the base lacks, and the TS build and offline fixture setup still need a spike before the 8 h tier and build cost can be trusted.
